name: test-hardening
description: Improve test quality without changing production behavior unless a discovered bug requires a separate decision.

stages.title: Identify test gaps and weak assertions
stages.instruction: Identify high-value missing cases, flaky patterns, weak assertions and uncovered invariants. Prioritize behavior, not line coverage alone.

stages.title: Add or strengthen tests
stages.instruction: Strengthen the test suite. Avoid production changes unless strictly required to expose test seams; flag discovered product bugs rather than silently changing behavior.
